question: Did the >=5-article corpus-coverage check ever exclude or replace a case, i.e. did the retrieval index gate cohort membership?
verdict: CONFIRMED: no case failed and none was replaced, so the check never altered cohort membership. P2 may remove it as an eligibility criterion with no re-run; pmc_article_count is a released descriptor of retrieval-result diversity, bounded above by the top-100 cut.
